column1: # Coordinates resolved via the Geocoding API, all verified country=RS.
# Each anchor sweeps a 10km circle (PrewarmGoogle's fixed NearbyRadiusKM,
# unchanged by T1 rating-and-anywhere-radius — see PrewarmGoogle's own doc).
# Coverage is places-people-go, not territory: filling Serbia geographically
# would be ~280 cells and mostly empty countryside.

column2: ' read -r c lat lng; do [ "${c#\#}" = "$c" ] || continue;
